name: Provide and maintain street lighting
definition: Street lighting provision and maintenance, excluding lighting integral to highway construction or operation where COFOG guidance provides otherwise.

public_name: Provide and maintain street lighting
public_definition: Street lighting provision and maintenance, excluding lighting integral to highway construction or operation where COFOG guidance provides otherwise.

name: Provide school travel education and behaviour-change programmes
definition: Educational programmes delivered through schools, distinguished from public-road infrastructure and traffic enforcement.

public_definition: Educational programmes delivered through schools, distinguished from public-road infrastructure and traffic enforcement.

public_name: Provide and maintain bicycle parking on school or campus property

name: Provide and maintain port access roads
definition: Road access infrastructure connecting ports to local and national networks. Classify the road itself as road transport infrastructure.

public_name: Provide and maintain port access roads
public_definition: Road access infrastructure connecting ports to local and national networks. Classify the road itself as road transport infrastructure.

name: Administer commercial road transport licensing
definition: Licensing and regulation of commercial passenger and freight road operators, subject to the statutory remit of the relevant national authority. Possible duplicate of RT-28 (open question).

public_name: Administer commercial road transport licensing
public_definition: Licensing and regulation of commercial passenger and freight road operators, subject to the statutory remit of the relevant national authority. Possible duplicate of RT-28 (open question).

name: Administer driver and vehicle standards
definition: Driver testing, vehicle roadworthiness inspection and associated national standards. Included in the wider model but not presumed to be an LA function.

public_name: Administer driver and vehicle standards
public_definition: Driver testing, vehicle roadworthiness inspection and associated national standards. Included in the wider model but not presumed to be an LA function.

name: Secure transport infrastructure through development management
definition: Transport impacts of planning applications, planning conditions requiring developer-delivered footpaths, cycle routes and junctions, development contributions (s.48 PDA 2000 → s.584 PDA 2024), discharge of conditions and release of security, and planning enforcement. Distinct from plan-making (X-08). v0.4: decision moves from S7 to S7D; S14 added (Decision 8).
register_note: Added v0.2 / Gap from scenario test 12
public_name: Secure transport infrastructure through development management
public_definition: Transport impacts of planning applications, planning conditions requiring developer-delivered footpaths, cycle routes and junctions, development contributions (s.48 PDA 2000 → s.584 PDA 2024), discharge of conditions and release of security, and planning enforcement. Distinct from plan-making (X-08).

name: Administer transport funding programmes
definition: Programme-level funding functions: programme terms and conditions, envelope allocations (e.g. DoT → NTA, TII; DoT → LAs by formula), programme co-ordination contracts and programme reporting. Allocation to individual projects stays in S3 of each asset or service activity. New in v0.4 (Decision 2).

name: License outdoor events (transport interface)
definition: Event licences for audiences of 5,000 or more (Part 16 of the Planning and Development Act 2024, s.479, and the Planning and Development (Licensing of Outdoor Events) Regulations 2026, S.I. No. 468 of 2026; Part XVI of the Planning and Development Act 2000 was repealed on 9 September 2026), whose conditions include traffic management plans agreed with the LA and An Garda Síochána. Road closures for events stay in RT-37. New in v0.4 (F31).
